methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 adjustable weight bench models (FID, flat, and folding). All models verified to exist. The REP AB-5000 Zero Gap is now DISCONTINUED at REP Fitness (its dedicated product page redirects to the catalog; the current lineup is AB-3000, AB-3100, Nighthawk, BlackWing, AB-5200 2.0) — kept for reference like the retired Marcy SB-670, with source.url repointed to the BarBend review since the manufacturer product page no longer resolves. The Marcy SB-670 is retired/sold-out per marcypro.com but included for reference (page still live). Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (repfitness.com, ironmaster.com, roguefitness.com, flybirdfitness.com, bowflex.com, finerform.com, forceusa.com, marcypro.com, fitrxrecovery.com) verified against independent outlets (BarBend, Garage Gym Lab, Garage Gym Reviews, Jay's Home Gym). Booleans indicate presence (true) or absence (false) of a feature; max_load_capacity_lb is a bare number; pad_thickness_in carries the unit in the value string; back_pad_positions and seat_positions are integer counts; weight_lb is a bare number; type is a controlled string (fid / flat / folding). Corrections this pass: Ironmaster price 499->449 (manufacturer current price) and release nulled (V2 launch year unverifiable); Rogue pad 2.5->2.25 in (Garage Gym Lab + Rogue premium pad set); NordicTrack seat_positions 4->null (only 4 overall configs documented, not 4 separate seat adjustments); AB-5000 source repointed (discontinued, manufacturer page dead). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: REP Fitness AB-3000 2.0 FID Adjustable Bench
products.provenance: Price $349.99 confirmed directly on repfitness.com product page (regular price). Specs (8 back positions -12 to 85 deg, 5 seat positions, 89.3 lb, 1000 lb capacity, -12 deg decline via leg rollers) confirmed on repfitness.com and BarBend 2026 review. Pad thickness not published by manufacturer — set to null (draft's 2.75 in could not be corroborated on the manufacturer page).

products.name: REP Fitness AB-5000 Zero Gap Adjustable Bench
products.priceNote: Last published MSRP (standard color); clear coat ~$680. DISCONTINUED — no longer listed on repfitness.com; superseded by AB-5200 2.0.
products.provenance: Product is now DISCONTINUED at REP Fitness — the dedicated product page redirects to the catalog (current lineup: AB-3000, AB-3100, Nighthawk, BlackWing, AB-5200 2.0). source.url repointed from the dead manufacturer page to the BarBend review. Last published MSRP ~$600 (clear coat ~$680) per BarBend. Specs (7 back positions 0-90 deg, 5 seat positions -15 to 45 deg, 117 lb, 1000 lb capacity, 2.25 in pad) confirmed via BarBend and Garage Gym Lab 2026 reviews. Decline requires optional leg roller attachment (~$110). Kept for reference like the retired Marcy SB-670.

products.name: REP Fitness BlackWing Adjustable Bench
products.priceNote: MSRP base from repfitness.com; wide pad +$20, leg roller +$110
products.provenance: Price $599.99 and specs (12 back positions -8 to 85 deg, 6 seat positions -10 to 45 deg, 131 lb, 1000 lb capacity, ZeroGap seat) confirmed on repfitness.com product page and BarBend 2026 review. products.name: Bowflex 5.1S Stowable Bench
products.priceNote: MSRP from bowflex.com; frequently discounted to $349
products.provenance: MSRP $499 confirmed on bowflex.com (shown at sale $349, '$150 Off'). 600 lb capacity, 6 back positions (30/45/60/90/flat/-20 deg decline), 60 lb bench weight confirmed from bowflex.com and global.bowflex.com. Seat positions (3) per Jay's Home Gym review. Pad thickness not published — null.

products.name: Flybird Adjustable Workout Bench FB149
products.provenance: Price $162, 800 lb capacity, 8 back positions (90 to -30 deg incl decline), 3 seat positions (flat/12/23 deg), 28.5 lb, 1.8 in pad all confirmed on flybirdfitness.com and corroborated by search of the FB149 listing. Current FB149 model.

products.name: Ironmaster Super Bench Pro V2
products.provenance: Price corrected 499->449: ironmaster.com product page currently lists $449 (was frequently shown at $499 list / $399 on 20% promo). Specs (11 back positions 0-85 deg, 3 seat positions, 1000 lb flat / 600 lb incline, 69 lb with seat, 2.5 in pad) confirmed on ironmaster.com and Garage Gym Lab. Release nulled: V2 launch year not reliably verifiable (V1 dates to 2018; V2 exact year unconfirmed).

products.name: Rogue Adjustable Bench 3.0
products.priceNote: MSRP from roguefitness.com; stainless rails option extra
products.provenance: Price $595 confirmed directly on roguefitness.com. Specs (10 back positions 0-85 deg, 3 seat positions 0/15/30 deg, 125 lb, no decline) confirmed on roguefitness.com and Garage Gym Lab. Capacity ~1000 lb (Rogue does not publish an exact rating; BarBend cites at least 1000 lb). Pad thickness corrected 2.5->2.25 in: Rogue's premium textured foam pad set is 2.25 in thick (Garage Gym Lab + Rogue pad listing).

products.priceNote: MSRP from forceusa.com; includes leg developer and preacher curl
products.provenance: Price $499, capacity 705 lb, 7 back positions (-15 deg decline to 80 deg incline), 3 seat positions, decline all confirmed directly on forceusa.com product page. Standalone bench weight not published — null. Pad thickness not published — null. Release year nulled (draft's 2022 was an approximation not confirmed by the manufacturer).

products.name: NordicTrack Utility Bench (NTBE19)
products.priceNote: Retail price at Best Buy / Lowe's / Academy
products.provenance: Price $299 confirmed via Best Buy and Lowe's listings. Capacity stated as 300 lb across retail listings (the Fitness For Life PR 610 lb figure is an outlier and not used). The bench offers 4 overall configurations (flat, incline, decline, military); back_pad_positions=4 reflects those settings. seat_positions corrected 4->null: no separate 4-position seat adjustment is documented — the original draft conflated the 4 overall configs as both back and seat counts. Bench weight (~70 lb product / 77 lb in-box across listings) and pad thickness not cleanly published — null.

products.priceNote: Last listed MSRP; product retired/sold out at marcypro.com
products.provenance: Price $229.99 confirmed on marcypro.com (marked Retired / sold out; page still live). Dunham's lists $199.99 secondary. Capacity 300 lb per marcypro.com (third-party 600 lb combined figure conflicts; manufacturer 300 lb used). 6 back positions and 3 seat positions per marcypro.com description and Jay's Home Gym review. Decline confirmed. Bench weight and pad thickness not published — null.

products.name: FitRx Workout Bench
products.priceNote: MSRP from fitrxrecovery.com; Walmart often discounts (seen ~$99)
products.provenance: Price $189.88 MSRP, 390 lb capacity (including user), 6 back positions, 35 lb bench weight confirmed on fitrxrecovery.com and Walmart listing. products.name: Finer Form Multi-Functional FID Weight Bench
products.provenance: Price $349.99, 1000 lb capacity, 8 back positions, 3 seat positions, 47 lb net weight, decline all confirmed on finerform.com product page. Pad thickness 2 in derived from manufacturer pad dimensions (48 x 2 x 7.8-11.8 in, where 2 in is the thickness). Also functions as Roman chair / hyperextension / preacher / sit-up bench.
